sources.title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
sources.venue_or_publisher: Foundations and Trends in Information Retrieval
sources.claim_supported: BM25 uses corpus IDF, saturating term frequency, and document-length normalization.
sources.limitations: Supports the BM25 method family, not Qdrant implementation details or the claim that k1=1.2, b=0.75, avg_len=256, tokenizer, or language settings are optimal for this acne corpus.

sources.title: BM25 inference and full-text search documentation
sources.claim_supported: Qdrant supports qdrant/bm25 document inference with explicit k, b, avg_len, tokenizer, language and IDF modifier.
sources.limitations: Provider implementation contract, not independent evidence of retrieval quality or parameter optimality on the project corpus.

sources.title: Gemini Embedding 2 model and embeddings documentation
sources.claim_supported: Gemini Embedding 2 supports 3072-dimensional output, does not accept task_type, and documents text-prefix instructions for text-only retrieval use cases.
sources.limitations: Provider contract only. It does not validate Vietnamese acne retrieval quality, the current unprefixed query/document format, or any improvement from retrieval-task instruction prefixes on this corpus.

sources.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
sources.claim_supported: Dense representations support semantic passage retrieval.
sources.limitations: Does not validate Gemini Embedding 2 or this medical corpus.

sources.title: Document Segmentation Matters for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
sources.venue_or_publisher: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025
sources.claim_supported: Document segmentation can affect retrieval and downstream RAG quality; the paper evaluates PIC on open-domain benchmarks.
sources.limitations: The project does not implement PIC. The paper does not prescribe or validate this project's 2400-character cap or acne corpus policy.

sources.title: Collections and distance metrics documentation
sources.claim_supported: Qdrant collections can use cosine distance for dense-vector similarity search and normalize vectors for efficient cosine scoring.
sources.project_method: Dense cosine vector search provider contract
sources.limitations: Defines provider behavior, not the relevance quality of Gemini vectors or retrieval effectiveness on the project corpus.

sources.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion Outperforms Condorcet and Individual Rank Learning Methods
sources.authors_or_organization: Gordon V. Cormack; Charles L. A. Clarke; Stefan Buettcher
sources.claim_supported: Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines ranked result lists using reciprocal rank contributions rather than raw score addition.
sources.project_method: Equal-weight Dense and BM25 rank fusion
sources.limitations: Does not prove that k=60 or equal Dense/BM25 weights are optimal for Acne Advisor AI.

sources.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
sources.claim_supported: Language-model reasoning traces can be interleaved with actions that acquire external information.
sources.project_method: Related conceptual basis for bounded semantic action selection
sources.limitations: The project does not reproduce the paper's prompting setup or expose free-form chain of thought; the paper does not define this project's action schema or safety transitions.

sources.title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
sources.claim_supported: Retrieval can be triggered actively according to model/evidence need during generation.
sources.project_method: Related conceptual basis for model-selected retrieve/retry actions
sources.limitations: The project does not implement FLARE or its token-level retrieval mechanism; the paper does not validate the two-attempt project limit.

sources.title: Adaptive-RAG: Learning to Adapt Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models through Question Complexity
sources.claim_supported: Retrieval strategy can be adapted to question complexity rather than fixed uniformly.
sources.project_method: Related conceptual basis for bounded request-dependent action selection
sources.limitations: The project does not implement the paper's classifier or strategy set; the paper does not define this project's AgentDecision schema.

sources.title: Timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter
sources.claim_supported: Finite timeouts, bounded retries, exponential backoff, and jitter mitigate correlated retry load in distributed systems.
sources.project_method: Bounded provider retry and shared request deadline
sources.limitations: Engineering guidance, not a scientific optimum; it does not prescribe the project's retry count, timeout values, backoff cap, or jitter ratio.

sources.title: Secure Hash Standard (SHS), FIPS PUB 180-4
sources.authors_or_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.claim_supported: SHA-256 is a standardized secure hash algorithm producing a 256-bit message digest.
sources.project_method: Exact cache identity and canonical pipeline fingerprint hashing
sources.limitations: The standard defines the hash algorithm; it does not validate project normalization, cache semantics, field selection, digest truncation, or authenticity.

sources.title: Universally Unique IDentifiers (UUIDs), RFC 9562
sources.authors_or_organization: Kyle Davis; Brad Peabody; Paul J. Leach
sources.claim_supported: UUID version 5 deterministically derives a UUID from a namespace and name using SHA-1 as specified by the standard.
sources.limitations: The standard defines UUIDv5 construction; it does not validate project canonical-name semantics, collision handling across changed namespaces, or data authenticity.

sources.title: Acne vulgaris: management (NG198)
sources.authors_or_organization: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
sources.publication_date: Official guideline published 2021-06-25; official metadata last updated 2026-04-30; local snapshot represented 2026-08-03
sources.claim_supported: Project evidence snapshot covering acne management, antibiotic stewardship, pregnancy and isotretinoin safety guidance.
sources.limitations: The local Markdown snapshot was acquired through a text-rendering transport and carries a represented date of 2026-08-03. It has not been independently verified as the complete current official version last updated 2026-04-30; current official-version provenance remains unresolved.

sources.title: Anaphylaxis and shortness of breath
sources.claim_supported: Medicine can trigger anaphylaxis; active breathing difficulty is an emergency symptom requiring immediate action.
sources.limitations: Supports a narrow emergency action boundary, not the project's exact phrase trigger, negation handling, diagnostic accuracy, or clinical validation. The related shortness-of-breath page is https://www.nhs.uk/symptoms/shortness-of-breath/.

sources.title: Severe bleeding first aid
sources.claim_supported: Severe bleeding requires prompt direct firm pressure and emergency assistance.
sources.limitations: The compatibility ID NHS_FIRST_AID_HEAVY_BLEEDING retains an older NHS URL that now redirects to St John Ambulance. This source does not validate the project's acne-specific phrase trigger or clinical effectiveness.

sources.title: Guidelines of care for the management of acne vulgaris
sources.authors_or_organization: Reynolds et al.; American Academy of Dermatology
sources.venue_or_publisher: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology
sources.claim_supported: Evidence-based acne treatment recommendations and antibiotic stewardship.
sources.limitations: Publisher copyright applies; only local controlled processing artifacts are retained.

sources.title: Huong dan chan doan va dieu tri cac benh da lieu - acne excerpt
sources.claim_supported: Vietnamese clinical terminology and acne diagnosis/treatment guidance.
sources.limitations: Local file is pages 433-442 only; stable direct official attachment URL was not discoverable.

sources.title: Dalacin T Topical Lotion Summary of Product Characteristics
sources.claim_supported: Dalacin T is a topical clindamycin phosphate product classified as a topical antibiotic for acne.
sources.project_method: Taxonomy and deterministic entity graph provenance
sources.limitations: Product availability and trade names are market-specific; the entity is used for identity resolution, not prescribing.

sources.title: Multi-publisher public acne education collection
sources.authors_or_organization: AAD; NHS; WebMD; DermNet; Healthline; Da Lieu Viet Nam
sources.venue_or_publisher: Six public health and dermatology publishers
sources.claim_supported: Patient-facing acne definitions, treatment and care information.
sources.limitations: This ID names the immutable parent acquisition artifact only. Record-level source IDs, publisher authority, URLs and raw text hashes are defined in data/sources/web_records.yaml; individual pages may change after retrieval.
